verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says you can 'use AI to build reports and dashboards' on labor cost trends and overtime, and shows a natural-language prompt ('Show me headcount vs plan') producing a dashboard. It also offers AI answers about benefits and pay changes and AI document review. This is AI-assisted reporting on in-product data, but the evidence is short marketing lines and shows no proactive AI insights or recommendations. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights and suggestions (not just prompt-built reports), in-depth first-party docs on the AI analytics features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
